text:
sophia: thinking of a mellow harbor paddle Sunday morning — anyone want to join? I can bring a spare spray skirt and a thermos. :thermometer:
Einar: i'm up for that if the wind stays < 12kts. what launch spot?
sophia: low tide near east slip, launch at 9 to catch the glassy water. plan to be off the dock by 9:15.
jamal: i have a plant swap on Saturday (tiny pots only!) — will be there with a pile of succulents :seedling:
lina: ooo plant swap details? i'm down for both days. kayaks sunday, swap saturday.
jamal: @lina roofdeck at marta's building, 4pm - bring labeled cuttings and a tray. no soil please, just damp paper towel.
marta: tiny note from the host: please keep gate codes off public threads and clean up pots after.
ops-bot: gentle reminder: rooftop events require registering with people-ops. RSVP here: https://intranet/events
alex: if kayak's on and i don't have transport, anyone going from downtown? can chip in for gas.
einar: @alex i can take two, have room in the car. will need room for a few plant boxes if jamal brings them.
sophia: carpool meet 8:10 @ 3rd & market. bring layers, sunscreen, and a small dry bag for phone.
lina: bringing sunscreen + a tiny first-aid kit. granola bars as emergency carbs. :bar_chart:
jamal: also bringing potting labels so folks don't forget which is which. excited for trades! :sparkles:
alex: can someone lend me a PFD? mine's in the closet at the old apartment.
einar: @alex i have an extra PFD, it's in my trunk.
sophia: perfect. weather check Sat night — if wind > 15kts we'll pivot to brunch at Parkside Diner (but let's hope no pancake consolation prize :pancakes:).
marta: i'll probably only make the swap saturday, so brunch backup for me.
lina: kayak > brunch but parkside lemon ricotta is tempting. will vote on poll.
sophia: @ops-bot can you drop a quick poll: "Harbor paddle or Parkside brunch?" ends in 5 hours.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Harbor paddle or Parkside brunch?" Options: Harbor paddle, Parkside brunch. Voting open for 5 hours.
jamal: voted Harbor paddle.
marta: voted Brunch (potting duties win)
alex: voted Harbor paddle.
sophia: looks like paddle is leading. final reminder: meet 8:10, launch 9am. bring a lightweight jacket. see y'all! :kayak:
